"""Four predefined development frames, full-frame production denoising controls."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import numpy as np
from analysis.render import available_memory,runtime_env
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT,sha256,git

INDICES=(0,4,8,13)


def run():
    if sys.byteorder!='little':raise ValueError('This isolated native archive contract requires little-endian')
    parent=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw/extraction-native-rafale-bruit-v001-20261027T230112Z.json'
    original=json.loads(parent.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));digest=sha256(parent)
    binary=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprBurstControls.exe';binary_hash=sha256(binary)
    p=Path(original['pixels']['path'])
    if sha256(p)!=original['pixels']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Native baseline changed')
    with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as saved:baseline=saved['planes'].copy()
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc);folder=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-production'/started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);records=[];pixels=[]
    for index in INDICES:
        if (available_memory() or 0)<5*1024**3:raise ValueError('Need5GiB before fullframe denoising')
        record=original['records'][index];raw=Path(record['path']);prefix=folder/raw.stem
        if sha256(raw)!=record['sha256']:raise ValueError('Changed source')
        subprocess.run([str(binary),str(prefix),str(raw)],env=runtime_env(binary),check=True,timeout=240)
        data=np.fromfile(prefix.with_suffix('.f32'),dtype='<f4').reshape(3,9,3,256,256)
        native=json.loads(prefix.with_suffix('.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        delta=float(np.max(abs(data[0]-baseline[index])))
        if not np.isfinite(data).all() or delta>2e-7 or native['sha256']!=record['sha256']:raise ValueError('Different baseline/native contract')
        pixels.append(data);records.append(dict(index=index,path=str(raw),sha256=record['sha256'],
            native=native,baseline_max_abs_delta=delta,binary_pixels_sha256=sha256(prefix.with_suffix('.f32'))))
        print('PRODUCTION',raw.name,'baseline-delta',delta,flush=True)
    stack=np.stack(pixels);archive=folder/'production-controls.npz'
    with archive.open('xb') as handle:np.savez_compressed(handle,planes=stack)
    if sha256(binary)!=binary_hash or sha256(parent)!=digest:raise ValueError('Changed dependencies')
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);output=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw'/f'temoins-production-rafale-bruit-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    sources=[ROOT/'tests/burst_tools/burst_controls.cpp',ROOT/'tests/burst_tools/CMakeLists.txt',ROOT/'src/tools/TestRecipes.cpp']
    result=dict(schema_version=1,data_version=1,started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parent=dict(path=str(parent),sha256=digest),records=records,
        binary=dict(path=str(binary),sha256=binary_hash,engine_sha256=sha256(ROOT/'build-patch_noise/Release/iprEngine.lib')),
        sources={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):dict(sha256=sha256(p),source=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in sources},
        runner_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)),runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
        pixels=dict(path=str(archive),sha256=sha256(archive),shape=list(stack.shape),dtype=str(stack.dtype)),
        rules='Frozendevelopmentindices0/4/8/13;productionfullframe0/50/100luma+chroma;sequential5GiBguard240s/file;baselineequalityagainstexistingnativeprobe2e-7max;no engine/sourcefilterchange.',
        limitations='Same scene ISO4000;not new noise algorithm or visual validation. Native binary engine prebuilt,source hashes do not certify reproducible build. No LR or clean reference claim. Validation/sealed remain closed.',
        verdict='production_controls_extracted_for_real_burst_evaluation')
    with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(result,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',output,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':run()
